Hi Elaine,

Great to meet with you and the Novara team today — appreciate you carving out time. Quick recap from our demo and next steps: 

- Highlights: Redwood Dedicated gives predictable throughput for your reranking and multi-tenant scoring pipelines, with KV-cache warm starts to reduce tail latency.
- Ask: confirm whether the priority is latency or cost for the initial integration (that will change the recommended instance/quantization profile).

Attached: pricing_deck_novara_v1.pdf (3 slides: pricing bands, config options, ROI example) and estimate_novara_2028-03-01.xlsx (example monthly cost by traffic tier).

Would love to walk through the numbers with you or procurement — 15 minutes is usually enough to answer questions. Are you available for any of these slots next week?
- Tue 3/6, 10:00–10:15 PT
- Tue 3/6, 15:00–15:15 PT
- Wed 3/7, 11:00–11:15 PT

If you prefer I can also share a one-pager that maps our configs to Novara's expected qps/latency.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
